lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe12O20 (reduced formula Fe3O5) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Fe environments coordinated by six O neighbors, with Fe–O distances of 1.92–2.13 Å, while O centers show four- or fivefold geometric coordination by Fe. The analysis also finds corner- and edge-sharing between Fe octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between O-centered five-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
